steps.title: T4 / T5 motion
steps.narration: Thousands of T4 and T5 cells tile the optic lobe and detect motion. A handful of skeletons stand in for the lattice.

steps.title: Feature detectors
steps.narration: LC10a tracks a small moving fly. LC4 and LPLC2 fire for looming objects.

steps.title: Widefield projection
steps.narration: LC6 and LC11 take optic-lobe features into the central brain — the jump from retina-adjacent cells to behavior.
